thread:
maria-cs: FYI — doing month-end recon for Acme Corp. Dashboard shows 98,764 tokens for Feb, invoice shows 100,321 tokens (+1,557). Line-level diff points to an 'embed' line present on invoice but missing from the dashboard export. invoice id INV-2026-ACME-02

jordan-support: can you paste the invoice line(s) and dashboard export? Also did they use Dedicated or Hosted? :thinking:

maria-cs: Hosted. Attached CSV from billing export (snippet):

```
invoice_line_id,product,tokens,plan,period
L-9843,api.generate,98764,pro,2026-02
L-9876,api.embed,1557,pro,2026-02
```

maria-cs: Dashboard CSV export only has api.generate row — no api.embed 1557 tokens.

kevin-billing: pinging ledger. The invoice generation job includes a delayed_embed_consolidation backfill that runs at cutoff. Did export include post-cutoff events? What timezone are we using for dashboard vs invoice?

li-analytics: Dashboard window is UTC 00:00-23:59:59 but UI rollup runs with a 20m lateness window; invoice uses billing_cutoff at account timezone America/Los_Angeles (PST) by default. That mismatch could move ~1k tokens across days.

sylvia-eng: Quick repro query (use for root cause):

```
-- counts tokens by event time vs billing_time
select event_type, sum(tokens) as tokens_by_event, sum(billing_tokens) as tokens_by_billing
from usage.events
where customer_id = 'acct_ACME'
and event_time >= '2026-02-28T00:00:00Z' and event_time < '2026-03-01T00:00:00Z'
group by 1;
```

sylvia-eng: ran it, found a batch of 1,555 embed events at 2026-03-01T00:03:12Z (UTC) with billing_time '2026-02-28T23:59:58-08:00' — the embed pipeline applied customer timezone adjustment. Those show up on invoice (billing_time) but dashboard (event_time) dropped them into March.

jordan-support: oh — so invoice is counting them in Feb, dashboard is showing them in March. That explains totals difference but why is there an extra 'embed' line on invoice? Shouldn't dashboard aggregate by product?

kevin-billing: Invoice job groups by product_name from billing_events table; there's a migration that introduced `product_name = 'api.embed'` for the consolidated embed stream. Dashboard uses real-time product tags which had 'api.generate' for mixed requests. So grouping diverged.

maria-cs: Customer sees higher invoice and is escalated. What's the fix and ETA?

sylvia-eng: Short fix: backfill dashboard rollup for Feb with billing_time-aligned aggregation and re-export CSV for Acme. Medium: change dashboard to support bill-time aligned view for month-end and annotate with billing cutoffs. Long: fix migration so consolidated embeds keep original product tags.

kevin-billing: I can trigger a one-off backfill. Steps:
1) run billing-aligned rollup job for acct_ACME for 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-28
2) regenerate dashboard CSV + re-run reconciliation
3) if totals align, issue corrected invoice adjustment credit of -1557 tokens / $X

kevin-billing: Doing step 1 now — job id run-backfill-326 (ETA ~25m). Will update.

ops-bot: backfill job run-backfill-326 started by kevin-billing at 2026-03-01T14:18:09Z

maria-cs: Thanks. Also patch note to include in customer reply: explain timezone cutoff + consolidated embed migration caused mis-attribution. Offer provisional credit and follow up when backfill completes. :thumbsup:

kevin-billing: backfill finished. Result: adjusted dashboard tokens for Feb -> 100,321 (matches invoice). Re-exported CSV and notified accounting to skip credit (we're not issuing a credit since invoice is correct).

jordan-support: I'll draft a message to Acme: short explanation + steps we took + link to reconciliation CSV

maria-cs: please cc me. Also add "we're updating dashboard rollup logic to show billing-aligned month views by Apr release" as a timeline.

jordan-support: Drafted — sending now. Message: "Thanks — after investigation we found some embed requests were billed against Feb due to customer timezone cutoff; invoice is correct and dashboard will be updated. Backfill confirmed totals match."

maria-cs: resolved for now, will monitor next month for other accounts that cross PST midnight.

li-analytics: I'll run a sweep query to find accounts with >500 token delta caused by billing_time != event_time and post results in #eng-billing tomorrow.

kevin-billing: assigning follow-up ticket BL-723 to billing-team. ETA for code fix: 3 weeks.

maria-cs: thanks everyone :heart:
